title: Albury, NSW - Infrastructure Restoration
current_summary: An unplanned access network outage affected some services in Albury, NSW. A loss of mains power at a network site was identified. Services were restored at 9:20 AM AEST on 10 July 2026.

updates.content: Some customers in Albury, NSW experienced a service interruption caused by a power issue at a network site. Services were restored at 9:20 AM AEST on 10 July 2026. If your service has not reconnected, please restart your modem/router and connection box (if you have one). If you still have trouble, please contact us and we will help.
